subject: Mutual action agreement: launch timeline, milestones & signature readiness
body_plaintext:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft and proposed launch cadence

Hi Lara / Miguel —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Agreement (MAP) we discussed — I pulled together milestones, owners, and target dates so we can align on responsibilities and hit a clean launch. High level:

- Target signature date: 2026-11-09
- Target go-live (production traffic): 2026-11-30
- Success criteria (minimal): 90th-pct latency < 350ms for 1k qps baseline, embedding throughput validated on a 1M-vector sample, and a security review completed with SOC2 evidence and a short penetration checklist

Milestones & owners (draft):
1) Procurement & PO issuance — Owner: Kestrel (Miguel) — Target: 2026-11-05
2) Legal review & DocuSign — Owner: Redwood Legal / Marissa — Target: 2026-11-09
3) Technical validation & sandbox sign-off — Owner: Aditya / Kestrel Eng — Target: 2026-11-16
4) Final rollout plan + smoke test window — Owner: Hannah / Kestrel PM — Target: 2026-11-27

Dependencies we flagged on the call: SOC2 evidence (we can share our report link), network/firewall rules for private VPC peering, and an integration window for your engineering team (we estimate 2 weeks of hands-on effort).

Next steps I propose:
- Lara/Miguel: review the attached MAP and mark changes by EOD Tue 10/20
- Marissa: prep an initial DocuSign envelope and confirm legal cadence
- Aditya: share exact sandbox credentials and a quick integration checklist by Mon 10/19

Attachment: [Kestrel_MAP_v1.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up if helpful — otherwise I'll track edits and push an updated PDF for signature-ready review.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Kestrel_MAP_v1.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

---

From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@kestrelhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft and proposed launch cadence

Thanks Hannah — this is very clear and close to what we need. A few notes from our side after reviewing with procurement and engineering:

- Procurement asks for PO issuance by 2026-11-05 (we'll try to hit that but need legal to finalize terms)
- Can you confirm where the SOC2 report is hosted? We need the latest version and the control mapping to our data retention policy
- Our security team also wants a targeted list of egress IPs for VPC peering testing (Aditya, can you add those to the checklist?)

We like the 11/09 signature target — if legal can turn quickly we'll lock this in. For go-live, Nov 30 works for our internal timeline assuming the sandbox sign-off completes on schedule.

I'll mark a couple of small edits in the attached and return by EOD Tue.

—Lara
Lara Chen
Director, Platform Engineering | Kestrel Health
lara.chen@kestrelhealth.com

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft and proposed launch cadence

Lara — quick answers from engineering:

- SOC2 report: link is https://redwood.app/s/security/soc2-2026 (I'll also attach a PDF to the updated MAP)
- Egress IPs for the sandbox: 34.82.120.11, 34.82.120.12, 34.82.120.13 (we'll provide a CIDR if you need a block)
- Sandbox access: I'll provision creds and an ephemeral API key today; expect an email with instructions in ~2 hours
- Integration estimate: 2 x SWE weeks for initial model calls and KV cache validation; we recommend scheduling 3 half-days of pairing sessions the week of 11/02

I've updated the MAP to include the SOC2 link and the IPs — see attached PDF.

Attachment: [Kestrel_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@kestrelhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft and proposed launch cadence

Lara — I'll own Legal/DocuSign on the Redwood side. Plan:

1) I'll send a redline-ready PDF to your counsel by 10/20 EOD; if we don't see comments we'll move to DocuSign by 11/03
2) I'll create the DocuSign envelope and share the link as soon as the final PDF is agreed — estimated DocuSign send date 11/04 if redlines finish on time
3) If Kestrel can commit a PO by 11/05 we'll prioritize Nov 09 signing; if PO slips we'll push signing to the next available date the week of 11/16

Also — we'll honor the pilot pricing for contracts signed by Nov 09. I can confirm final SOW language in the DocuSign envelope.

Link (internal): https://redwood.app/s/legal/KST-K-2026

—Marissa

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft and proposed launch cadence

All — we reviewed internally and Kestrel is green to proceed:

- We confirm the target signature date 2026-11-09 and will issue PO by 2026-11-05
- SOC2 link received and validated by our security team
- Integration window confirmed; engineering will be available for pairing sessions the week of 11/02
- Success criteria accepted as written; go-live date confirmed for 2026-11-30

Please send the DocuSign envelope when ready. Once received I'll route to our legal for final sign-off. Happy to sign once the invoice/PO are matched. Looking forward to kickoff.

Thanks,
Lara
